hero.title: Help shape {{app_name}}'s future
hero.description: Join our advanced testing program and provide valuable feedback as we refine {{app_name}}'s reflective AI conversations. Your insights will directly influence how we build this emotional support tool.

occupation.label: Occupation / Role
occupation.placeholder: e.g., Software Engineer, Teacher, Student, etc.
occupation.helpText: Helps us understand different user perspectives and needs.

struggles.label: General Struggles / Emotional Challenges
struggles.placeholder: What emotional challenges or life situations would you like support with? (e.g., work stress, relationship concerns, decision-making, etc.)
struggles.helpText: Share what you'd like help processing or reflecting on. This helps us understand your needs.

coping.label: Coping Mechanisms / How You Manage Stress
coping.placeholder: How do you currently handle stress or difficult emotions? (e.g., journaling, exercise, talking to friends, meditation, etc.)
coping.helpText: Understanding your current strategies helps us build better complementary tools.

source.label: How Did You Hear About {{app_name}}?
source.placeholder: e.g., Twitter, friend referral, blog post, etc.
source.helpText: Helps us understand which outreach efforts are most effective.

notes.label: Additional Comments / Notes
notes.placeholder: Anything else you'd like us to know about your interest in {{app_name}} or feedback on emotional AI tools?
notes.helpText: Share any other thoughts, questions, or specific areas you'd like to focus on during testing.

form.thankYouNote: Thank you for your interest in helping shape {{app_name}}. We'll review applications and reach out to selected testers as we expand our program. Remember, {{app_name}} is not therapy or a crisis service.
